answer_1.quote: As an important task in Natural Language Processing, dialogue generation systems aim to generate fluent and informative responses based on the dialogue context .

answer_2.quote: We employ improved versions of BLEU and ROUGE-L, which can better correlate n-gram overlap with human judgment ... We adopt the implementation of distinct-1/2 metrics following previous study .

answer_4.quote: We conduct human evaluation to further confirm the effectiveness of the PVHD. ... D, R, F represent diversity, relevance and fluency, respectively.
answer_4.guideline: Human annotators were asked to rate each generated response on three criteria: diversity, relevance, and fluency.
